name: WTU-Eval
description: WTU-Eval is a benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' ability to decide whether to use external tools or not, reflecting real-world scenarios where tool use is uncertain and incorrect usage can impair performance.
reputation: A recent benchmark with emerging interest for tool-use reasoning, but not yet a widely standardized evaluation suite.
notes: Includes 11 datasets (6 tool-usage, 5 general); fine-tuning improves tool decision-making and reduces incorrect tool use.
